scope: Original reusable SVG components for selected source-checked SysML notation. A component is not a complete graphical grammar or a conformance result.

shapes.name: Part definition
shapes.label: Wheel
shapes.description: Minimal sharp-corner part definition node with an editable name label.
shapes.limits: No compartments, boundary ports, aliases or additional prefixes. The host renderer supplies these when required.

shapes.name: Composite part usage
shapes.label: wheel : Wheel
shapes.description: Minimal solid rounded part usage node with an editable name/type label.
shapes.limits: Represents the composite example. Prefix combinations, compartments and port attachments are not included.

shapes.name: Referential part usage
shapes.label: spare : Wheel[0..1]
shapes.description: Dashed rounded referential part usage node, retaining its ref part keyword.
shapes.limits: This remains a PartUsage. The displayed multiplicity is an example, not a default or a validation result.

shapes.name: Full port usage
shapes.label: hub : Mount
shapes.description: Minimal full port usage node with an editable name/type label.
shapes.limits: This is the full node form. Nested ports, direction glyphs and reference/proxy alternatives are omitted.

shapes.name: Boundary port glyph
shapes.description: Small rounded undirected boundary port glyph, supplied as a component without a label or host node.
shapes.limits: Glyph only. Place it on the appropriate boundary and supply the position-specific port label. It does not include arrows, dotted references, nested ports or proxy dots.

shapes.name: Full connection usage
shapes.label: link
shapes.limits: No compartments or elaboration links. The host renderer determines how the modeled connection is related to its endpoints.

shapes.name: Binary connection edge
shapes.label: link
shapes.description: Solid undirected binary connection line with an editable optional label.
shapes.limits: Attach start/end anchors to valid connection ends. Direction indication, roles, multiplicities and adornments are omitted. This line does not imply flow direction.

shapes.name: Three-ended connection
shapes.label: link
shapes.description: Representative three-ended usage connection with a filled central dot and solid segments.
shapes.limits: A fixed layout with three endpoint anchors. The host renderer must reroute or add segments for other layouts/end counts. Role labels and multiplicities are omitted.

shapes.name: Binding connection
shapes.description: Solid binding line with the required equals sign.
shapes.limits: Endpoint usage nodes must have compatible types. The equals sign is fixed; the component does not validate endpoint compatibility.
